shops.name: Bombaclat's Home Goods
greeting: Wagwan, welcome to Bombaclat's Home Goods! Fresh stock every day, built with my own two teeth.
New furniture arrives every morning. Come back tomorrow, the shelf changes, ahlie.
thanks: Sold! Dam, that's a good choice.
Pleasure doing business, fam. Decorate with F at home!
That piece is gonna slap in your room.

shops.name: Hazel's Threads

New looks every day! Try it on in your wardrobe at home.
thanks: Yes, it's giving. Put it on at your wardrobe!
Your outfit just got a glow-up, darling.

shops.name: Parmeet's Anime Den
greeting: Irasshaimase! Uh, I mean, welcome to Parmeet's Anime Den, fam.
New merch drops daily. Posters, plushies, and absolutely zero spoilers.
thanks: Nice. Your room's power level is rising.
Sugoi! Hang it with F at home.

shops.name: Shooters Drug Mart
greeting: What's good? Shooters Drug Mart. Snacks make you walk faster. That's science, don't check.
Chips, candy, granola bars. Eat 'em from your bag with I. Medicine's at The Well, round the side.
thanks: Enjoy, fam. Press I to eat it.

shops.name: The Well. Get it? Lol i'm acc so creative
greeting: The Well, Shooters' pharmacy corner. Pricey, but you'll feel quick and sharp for two hours.
NyQuil goes straight to the farm squirrels. Sleepy squirrels, safe matcha.
thanks: Feel better, fam. Press I to take it.
That's the good stuff. Don't mix it with matcha. Kidding. Probably.

shops.name: Ramy's Salon
greeting: Welcome to Ramy's Salon. Hair, colour, eyes: pick a look and it's on before you blink.
Every change is paid each time, so choose with your heart. Or your wallet.
thanks: Stunning. I'm a genius. You're welcome.
